gloss: playing at a rocky shore; tide pool exploration

definitions.gloss: playing at a rocky shore; tide pool exploration
definitions.explanation: Recreational time spent at a rocky seashore, especially looking for small creatures in tide pools at low tide. A popular family outing in spring and summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{磯遊|いそあそ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went tide pooling with the kids.

examples.japanese: {磯遊|いそあそ}び⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大潮|おおしお}→大潮：27211_ooshio⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧だ。
examples.english: Spring spring tides are the best time for tide pool exploration.

examples.japanese: {磯遊|いそあそ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{時|とき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{滑|すべ}り→滑る：01230_suberu⟧にくい⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: When you go tide pooling, don't forget non-slip shoes and a hat.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{磯|いそ}→磯：05389_iso⟧ (rocky shore) + ⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧ (play). A classic seasonal activity, traditionally enjoyed around the spring ⟦{大潮|おおしお}→大潮：27211_ooshio⟧ (spring tides) when low tide exposes the most tide pools.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {磯遊|いそあそ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go tide pooling
- {磯遊|いそあそ}び⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧: to go out for tide pooling
- {磯遊|いそあそ}び⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧: tide-pooling spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{潮干狩|しおひが}り→潮干狩り：18507_shiohigari⟧: clam digging — specifically gathering shellfish on tidal flats
- ⟦{海水浴|かいすいよく}→海水浴：10972_kaisuiyoku⟧: swimming at the beach — at a sandy beach, not rocky shore
